description: Integrate all editor tool panels with backend services. Update tool panel components (StickersToolPanel, FiltersToolPanel, CaptionsToolPanel, SoundFXToolPanel, TextToolPanel, VoiceToolPanel, AdjustToolPanel, DoodlesToolPanel) to call the service layer instead of using hardcoded/fallback data. Replace direct apiClient.get() calls with service methods. Add proper loading, error, and empty states. Verify all panels work end-to-end with backend.
steps: Update StickersToolPanel.tsx: import stickerEmojiService, replace apiClient.get() with listStickers(), add error handling and loading state
Update FiltersToolPanel.tsx: import filterLibraryService, replace apiClient.get() with listFilters(), add error handling and loading state
Update SoundFXToolPanel.tsx: import soundFXService (already exists), replace apiClient.get() calls with soundFXService methods, verify search and preview work
Update CaptionsToolPanel.tsx: import captionsService, use autoCaption() to generate captions from video, handle async processing
Update TextToolPanel.tsx: ensure it doesn't need backend integration (text is local), verify state management works with timeline
Update VoiceToolPanel.tsx: ensure voiceoverService methods are called for recording/saving, verify audio recording works
Update AdjustToolPanel.tsx: ensure adjustments are applied locally (no backend call needed for brightness/contrast/saturation/exposure)
Update DoodlesToolPanel.tsx: ensure doodles are stored locally in state (no backend call needed)
Test each tool: click button in bottom nav, verify panel opens, verify data loads from backend, verify actions (add/preview/search) work
acceptance_criteria: All tool panels import and use service layer methods
No direct apiClient.get() calls in components (except through services)
Each panel shows loading spinner while fetching
Each panel shows error message on API failure
Each panel shows empty state when no data found
All panels compile without TypeScript errors
Backend calls succeed (check network tab or logs)
verification: Test each tool: Filters, Text, Voice, Captions, Adjust, Doodles, Sound FX, Stickers, Audio, Transitions (if exists)
Visual: Each opens a panel, shows content, loading/error states work
Network: Postman or network tab shows successful API calls to correct endpoints
